dimensions.comment: Both notes accurately capture the clinical details without major hallucinations.

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.comment: Gold includes a bit more detail on shoulder aggravating factors and sleep disturbance, but Notera is very comprehensive.

dimensions.name: Structure
dimensions.comment: Both follow a clear SOAP format with numbered plans.

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.comment: Both notes are exceptionally clear and easy to read.

Notera mentions an X-ray in addition to the ultrasound.
supraspinatus-tendonitis.summary: Both notes are of high clinical quality. The Gold note provides slightly more granular subjective history regarding the shoulder pain, while Notera captures all critical management plans and diagnoses accurately.
